resolvedReviewFindings.details: New CheckpointRetention captures exact project workflow ownership before app erasure, discovers descendant/fork metadata without loading content, protects active ancestors and descendants, double-checks terminal state, waits after recent cancellation, and erases via public DBOSClient APIs. Completed checkpoint retention is measured from completion time. Durable receipts preserve pending retries; no project is marked purged until cleanup is verified.
resolvedReviewFindings.runtimeSafety: Only disposable isolated test DBOS databases were cleaned during verification. Running application workflows and DBOS schemas were not directly modified.

operationalConstraints: Manual Conductor resume/rewind must be excluded while terminal checkpoint cleanup runs; DBOS public deletion has no atomic conditional-status argument, so the application rechecks the graph and statuses immediately before deletion.
Workflow families over 1000 nodes, unknown states or unsupported shard ownership remain pending for operator handling.
Checkpoint cleanup is retried by the existing hourly retention workflow; a running deletion workflow cannot erase its own checkpoint until a later pass.
